summary: Tested Segnalatori Competenze and the new Visualizzatore role. Backend: the new test_segnalazioni_competenze_visualizzatore.py passes 16/17. The combined segnalazioni suite passes 77/78 after I updated the old export test's expected HEADERS to include the new 'Competenze' column. The one failure is that competenze_by leaks to the segnalatore. Verified in the backend: /options returns competenze ['Rea','Andrea']. Admin PUT /competenze persists; setting a value to '' removes it; an invalid value or a key not among the sotto esiti gives 400; KO and not-yet-esitato segnalazioni give 400. BO, visualizzatore and segnalatore all get 403. BO sees competenze in list and detail; the segnalatore does not get competenze or the in_carico fields. When an esito change drops a sotto esito, its competenza is removed, and KO clears all of them. The Excel export has the 'Competenze' column with 'OK Gas: Rea'. Visualizzatore sees the same set as admin, plus detail, stats, options and the segnalatori list; da-lavorare count is 0. Visualizzatore gets 403 on create, esito, assegnazione, presa-in-carico, upload and export; downloading an existing document returns 200. Admin can create a role=visualizzatore user, update it and delete it. Frontend: admin on an OK segnalazione sees competenze-form with competenza-select-0 and -1 (options '- Nessuna -', Rea, Andrea); saving shows a toast, and resetting to Nessuna works. Admin on a KO segnalazione sees neither the form nor the view. BO sees the read-only competenze-view ('OK Gas → Andrea ...') and no form. Segnalatore sees neither. Visualizzatore: sidebar shows only 'Segnalatori', the commessa selector is hidden, subtitle 'sola lettura', all 4 rows, stats and the segnalatore filter. Visualizzatore has no new-segnalazione-btn, no export button, no presa-in-carico box, no esito or assegnazione forms and no upload picker; competenze-view is visible and the download triggers 'prova.txt'. In Utenti, Create user with 'Visualizzatore Segnalazioni' created a user with role visualizzatore, and the edit dialog shows the role.

critical.issue: DATA LEAK (pre-existing, also affects segnalatore): visualizzatore_test and segnalatore_test both get all leads (total 68, 50 per page) with full PII. The get_leads role filter only scopes agente, referente and super_referente; any other role falls through to unscoped. Visualizzatore must only see segnalazioni. Fix: return 403 or an empty result for SEGNALATORE/VISUALIZZATORE (ideally use a whitelist of roles).

minor.issue: _hidden_fields hides 'competenze' but not 'competenze_by', so the segnalatore can still see that competenze were set (and by whom). Add competenze_by: 0. Also consider hiding esito_by and assegnato_by if they are meant to be internal.

These return 200 (only the user's own record or empty lists, so no leak observed). Worth checking the other generic CRM endpoints (e.g. /api/leads above, dashboard) for visualizzatore and segnalatore, which fall through role checks.

issues: The 'Gestione Entità' (Solo Clienti) select still shows, but it is irrelevant for this role. Hiding it would be cleaner.

action_items: HIGH: Scope GET /api/leads (and any other generic CRM list endpoints) so that the visualizzatore and segnalatore roles get 403 or empty results; they currently see all leads
Optional: hide 'Gestione Entità' in the user dialog for the visualizzatore and segnalatore roles
critical_code_review_comments: update_competenze validates keys against sotto_esiti and values against COMPETENZE. This is correct. CompetenzeUpdate.competenze is an untyped dict, so Dict[str, str] would be stricter: a non-string value such as a list currently fails with a 400 only by accident.

update_esito filters competenze by the new sotto esiti, which is correct. It reads seg['competenze'] before the atomic update, so an admin competenze save made at the same moment could be overwritten (low risk).
UI: DocumentsSection receives canUpload={role !== 'visualizzatore'} and the backend also returns 403. Both layers enforce it, which is good.
seed_data_creation: TEST_COMP segnalazioni and test_vis_* users were created and then deleted. Seed segnalazione 'Mario TestSegn' competenze are now {'OK Gas': 'Rea'} (OK Mobile reset to none). visualizzatore_test had password_change_required=True; I set it to False so it could log in through the UI. No passwords were changed.

In the shadcn Select inside the user dialog, do NOT force-click options in a long list: scroll_into_view first, or it picks the wrong role.
